GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly, kicked up from the inside barrier and led fence by a half length settling down, Held Together in front & led 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed at the 300m and Lost Ground from there. [Stewards: Rider expressed satisfaction with its performance, adding he had not intended to lead, but from the inside draw was able to settle further forward due to the early tempo.] # faded once headed
Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 6.5 Lengths on fence, railed up to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifetd off heels Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line # slow/ran on fairly
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up on turn then hooked Wide Straightening Up , Made Ground in Straight # ran on ok
Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 4 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground along fence in straight. # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Carried in over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back 3rd last rails 4 Lengths 700m, started to work into the race and was behind Leaders Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up , peeled off heels last 200m and battled on well to be beaten less than a length # not far away

Jumped only fairly & a bit slow into stride, Settled Down 5.5 Lengths on fence, forced 3 Wide at 800m, Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover turning, hooked wider Straightening Up , Lost Ground but did move up into 4th place in Straight # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. From the 800m forced wider and when being steadied raced with its head in the air momentarily. Near the 450m, steadied when racing in restricted room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Just off speed 1 Lengths 800m, worked Two Wide outside leader at 700m, loomed to challenge Straightening Up but could not get the better of Leader late and had to settle for second spot # held second
Jumped okay then hampered & Settled Down 2.25 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Ground moving from 4th to 3rd in Straight but never a threat # battled on fairly

Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 3 Lengths 800m, came 3 Wide soon after Straightening Up , knuckled down last 200m and took over last 100m for strong win # finished too well

Jumped well. Pushed fwd & raced behind leader on inside (2L from lead) early . Tracked leader on inside midrace & pushed to hold ground @ 500m. Two Wide @ 400m & chasing 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & held ground in last 150m. # One-paced.
Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out Straightening Up and Made Good Ground in Straight charging late # just missed
